summary: Montra iteration 11 regression: full backend suite (125/125 passing serial, 146.02s) + frontend web preview verified. Backend: (a) updated legacy /api/fx assertions in test_iteration2.py and test_iteration3.py from `updated_at` -> new shape `snapshot_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) + `refreshed_today` (bool); (b) added test_iteration11.py (6 tests) covering brand rename ('Montra API' at /api/), FX new-shape response, consecutive same-user calls flip refreshed_today True->False with identical snapshot_date and rates, user doc fx_snapshot persistence (date + rates dict), and balances/insights convert_amount regression. GET /api/ live-verified via curl -> {"message":"Montra API","ok":true}. Frontend: login screen renders Montra brand + 'Money Mantra' tagline + light-green tintedBg + 3 feature cards (feature-0/1/2 testIDs visible) + dark-green pill 'Continue with Google' button. Zero PAGEERRORs, zero 'Property styles doesn't exist' render errors. All three unauth routes (`/(tabs)/dashboard`, `/insights`, `/expense/xyz`) redirect to /login cleanly. Only observation: RN-Web deprecation warning `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"` — minor, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.component: login.tsx featureCard style (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) — and any other screens using shadow* props
react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking on web preview but will surface repeatedly in every dev-console; consider migrating to `boxShadow` (RN 0.76+) or gating shadow* behind Platform.OS !== 'web'. critical_code_review_comments: server.py:714-727 get_rates_for_user is a clean, correct daily-snapshot pattern: snapshot keyed by user_id + UTC date; single write per user per UTC day; falls back to in-memory 30-min cache via get_rates() for the actual quote fetch. Idempotent second call in-day short-circuits without a Mongo write.

login.tsx correctly uses `useMemo(() => makeStyles(colors), [colors])` (line 12) — matches the pattern that fixed the earlier 'Property styles doesn\'t exist' render error. Same pattern needs to be preserved wherever theme-derived StyleSheet is inlined.

test_api.py:16 uses only `ok is True` assertion — brand-rename regression is now covered by new test_iteration11.py TestBrandRename explicitly asserting message == 'Montra API'.

FX contract change is backwards-incompatible for any frontend still reading `updated_at`. Confirm FxContext.tsx consumes `snapshot_date`/`refreshed_today` (not tested end-to-end here since auth-gated).
